Worktrees are unsafe for this phase due to shared `folder.test.ts` between 63-01/63-04, api:generate leaks, and node_modules conflicts; planner explicitly recommended sequential in-tree execution
Phase 63 branch `feat/read-chain-navigation-and-rotation-core` already existed from discuss-phase; executor must NOT re-fork off main to avoid losing planning commits
CI health poll uses `curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health` on port 3000 — mirrors the pattern that replaced fragile `sleep 12` in 63-07
The `.planning/codebase/` map drift is non-blocking at plan time when CONTEXT.md + RESEARCH.md carry precise, verified implementation-site references

workflow: GSD plan-checker iteration loop: trivial deterministic fixes (formatting/tracking) can be applied directly by orchestrator without replanning, then re-spawning the independent checker preserves gate integrity
Plan-checker findings categories: coverage/decision audit passes are the meaningful gates; artifact formatting issues (RESEARCH.md markers, VALIDATION.md fill) are fixable without design judgment
Commit signing should be verified disabled before autonomous AFK runs to prevent biometric prompt hangs; `git config --local commit.gpgsign false` is the safe local override
Nyquist VALIDATION.md body is populated during planning (step 5.5 writes frontmatter only; per-task map filled after plans exist with actual task IDs and automated commands)
Sequential in-tree execution is preferred over worktrees when plans share test files or have barrel/build-order dependencies
